note: Open-source repositories shown in the last research folder on the homepage. Add a repo to a group, or add a group. Descriptions are one sentence each.

repos.name: point_pattern_studio
repos.description: Generate random, clustered and regular dot patterns, score each from −1 to +1 with Ripley's L(r), and pointillize line drawings to a target score.
repos.description_zh: 產生隨機、聚集與規則點圖，以 Ripley's L(r) 為每張圖打出 −1 到 +1 的分數，並把線稿點描到指定分數。

repos.name: de-Dimension
repos.description: SOMTrack: locomotion metrics from tracking data, SOM and other projections, and the statistics that say whether groups really differ.
repos.description_zh: SOMTrack：從追蹤資料計算運動指標，以 SOM 等方法投影分群，並用 PERMANOVA 與置換檢定判斷組間差異是否真的存在。

repos.name: Voronoi_Cell_ODE
repos.description: Simulate Notch signalling on Voronoi cell layouts (honeycomb, random or imported) and export the results as videos and figures.
repos.description_zh: 在 Voronoi 細胞排列（蜂巢、隨機或匯入）上模擬 Notch 訊號，並輸出成影片與圖表。
repos.note: Runs the code you type into it: use it on your own computer only.
repos.note_zh: 會執行輸入的程式碼，請只在自己的電腦上使用。

repos.name: MSS
repos.description: Search for the best model, scaler and augmentation on small regression datasets, plus AutoEncoders that convert multispectral spectra.
repos.description_zh: 為小樣本回歸資料找出最佳的模型、資料縮放與增強方法，以及轉換多光譜光譜的 AutoEncoder。

repos.name: TrackBox
repos.description: A foldable imaging box for 6–7 dpf zebrafish larvae in 6- or 24-well plates, built for under 5,000 TWD, with capture software and temperature logging.
repos.description_zh: 拍攝 6–7 dpf 斑馬魚幼魚的可折疊攝影箱，適用 6 孔與 24 孔盤，材料費不到 5,000 元，附拍攝軟體與溫濕度記錄。

repos.name: spatial_pattern_analyzer
repos.description: A desktop tool that tests 2D cell coordinates from CSV or Excel with Ripley's K and L functions, for several cell types at once.
repos.description_zh: 以 Ripley's K 與 L 函數分析 CSV／Excel 二維細胞座標的桌面工具，可同時處理多種細胞類型。

repos.name: zVision
repos.description: YOLO models for the zebrafish lab (larvae on a wide camera or a stereomicroscope, adult keypoints) and UVC Lab for multi-camera capture and tracking.
repos.description_zh: 斑馬魚實驗室的 YOLO 模型（廣角或解剖顯微鏡下的幼魚、成魚關鍵點），以及多相機拍攝與追蹤的 UVC Lab。

repos.name: FOMA_lite
repos.description: A Streamlit app that compares FOMA data augmentation variants for regression, adapted from Kaufman et al. (ICML 2024).
repos.description_zh: 比較 FOMA 回歸資料增強方法的 Streamlit 介面，改寫自 Kaufman 等人（ICML 2024）。

repos.name: regression_models
repos.description: A desktop app that trains, compares and deploys regression models on small scientific datasets, from a spreadsheet to predictions.
repos.description_zh: 針對小型科學資料集訓練、比較與部署回歸模型的桌面程式，從試算表一路到預測。

repos.name: scrum-game
repos.description: 敏捷團隊蓋房子: printable cards for a classroom game in which an agile team builds a house, sprint by sprint.
repos.description_zh: 敏捷團隊蓋房子：課堂用的 Scrum 教學卡牌，讓團隊一個衝刺接一個衝刺地把房子蓋起來，可直接列印。

repos.name: endless_plan
repos.description: Ocean Probe Challenge: write one strategy function that steers a probe through endless seeded levels. A Colab assignment for intro Python, with a Windows build.
repos.description_zh: 海洋探勘 AI 挑戰：寫一個策略函數，操控探測船闖過無限生成的關卡。適合 Python 入門課的 Colab 作業，附 Windows 版。

repos.name: subtitle-cut
repos.description: Local subtitle editing and speech recognition with Qwen3 ASR: word-level video cutting, live transcription and speaker separation.
repos.description_zh: 以 Qwen3 ASR 在本機做字幕剪輯與語音辨識：逐字剪片、即時轉錄與說話者分離。

repos.name: ESP32-AIoT-Python
repos.description: ESP32 + MicroPython smart aquarium: the code for a 16-chapter AIoT course, and a web dashboard that connects all its devices.
repos.description_zh: ESP32 + MicroPython 智慧 AIoT 魚缸：16 章課程的程式碼，以及串接所有裝置的網頁資訊面板。

repos.name: ComVis
repos.description: AI image recognition course: video lessons with Jupyter notebooks, from Python and OpenCV basics to applications.
repos.description_zh: AI 影像辨識線上課程：教學影片搭配 Jupyter 筆記本，從 Python、OpenCV 基礎到應用。
